description: Read the language a brand's AI-generated content is written in (posts, blogs, SEO articles, landing pages, side pages). Always returns a concrete BCP-47 code; a brand that has never set one reports 'en'. Also returns 'supported' — the codes this account can switch to (en, es, pt-BR, de, fr, cs), read from the server so it stays right even if this MCP build is older than the platform. This is separate from the dashboard's interface language — the two are independent settings.
name: get_brand_content_language
